Produced by host discovery and enumeration, not by a language provider: file membership, package manifests and the VCS observation are the same in every language mode, including syntax-only and a repository with no TypeScript or Rust unit at all. The matrix previously named no capability for these three relations, so it did not say which component produced them (CB3-ADV-3, advisory severity preserved); they are stated here rather than left implicit. In a repository with no compiler unit their universe is native.semantic-universe.syntax.v2 (section 1.2).
